rh.pre_stated_method.consistent_toleranc.reason: The report states a mean-plus-one-standard-error variance rule, but the gate-selection code tests the mean alone. It then declares all three datasets passing using the primary audit results. NMS fails the stated rule: its mean plus conventional standard error is approximately 2.065, exceeding 2. Even dividing the logged population SD by sqrt(3) gives 2.00555. This is a contradictory decision-rule claim, not merely failure to meet a scientific target.
